_comment: WinForms client configuration. Copy this file to appsettings.json and fill in real values there - appsettings.json is gitignored so real credentials never get committed. ApiBaseUrl is used by every module already converted to call SNAP.api. ConnectionStrings is a temporary bridge for modules not yet converted (Equipment, Finance, Package, Reports, User Management, Payment, System Admin, Booking's New/Edit dialog) - remove each entry as its module is migrated to the API.
